answers.zh: 我们可安排把 SIM 寄给顾客。收到 SIM 后，顾客需按照 TuneTalk 指定方式自行完成实名注册；需要协助可联系 WhatsApp。
answers.en: SIM delivery can be arranged. After receiving it, the customer must complete identity registration through the TuneTalk-authorised method. Contact WhatsApp for help.
answers.ms: Penghantaran SIM boleh diatur. Selepas menerima SIM, pelanggan perlu melengkapkan pendaftaran identiti melalui kaedah yang dibenarkan TuneTalk. Hubungi WhatsApp untuk bantuan.

answers.zh: 营业时间为下午 1:00 至晚上 10:00。到店前建议先通过 WhatsApp 确认。
answers.en: Business hours are 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM. Please confirm by WhatsApp before visiting.
answers.ms: Waktu operasi ialah 1:00 petang hingga 10:00 malam. Sila sahkan melalui WhatsApp sebelum datang.
